description: This PHP source file defines the 'Each' validation rule class in a validation framework. It ensures that each element within an iterable input satisfies a specified composite rule.

classes.name: Each
classes.description: A validation rule that checks whether all elements in an iterable input satisfy a specified composite rule.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Each validation rule with a specific composite rule to apply to each element.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that all elements in the input list pass the composite rule. Throws an error if input is not iterable or returns false if any element fails the rule.
